title: 托福官方套题 09 · 口语

tasks.sample: (WA) Welcome to our interactive city tour.
(WA) Explore nearby restaurants for local food.
(WA) Use the transportation icon to find places to visit.
(WA) Check for hotel vacancies by using the button here.
(WA) Zoom in on the map for a detailed view of locations.
(WA) You can save your favorite places for easy access and return to them later.
(WA) If museum hours change, or if traffic is bad, you can find that information too.

tasks.stem: (Interviewer) Thank you for joining the study. I’d like to ask you about your travel experiences. [2-second pause] What items are essential for you when you travel? Do you tend to pack light or take as much as possible? Please explain.
(Interviewer) I see. When you travel, do you prefer to plan everything in advance, or do you like to be spontaneous? Why?
(Interviewer) Interesting. While some people choose to journey to distant and unfamiliar destinations, others feel more comfortable traveling closer to home. Which do you prefer and why?
(Interviewer) Good points. For my final question, in the future, do you think people will travel more frequently or less frequently? What factors do you think will influence this trend?
